feeds.title: All That Philly Jazz
feeds.description: A place-based public history project at the intersection of art, public policy and cultural heritage preservation. Drawing on archival materials and oral histories, we contextualize the social history of jazz. We dig in the archives to uncover hidden and forgotten stories.
